diagnostic.question: With actual original selected source prefixes, does the existing MG28 3-prior/0.75/0.10 nonterminal changed-public proposal meaningfully differ from policy's original selected action AND from same-history action-only proposals? Does it ever have prior task-relevant public target/door evidence?
diagnostic.predict_prior: own preceding genuine source actions/changed public before next decision; full accumulated memory per own family across 2 exposed DEV episodes; never future or other actors
diagnostic.full_context: literal original source mission + heading + original front pixel [3,5] + actual original action

candidate_rule.tie: lowest action index unless source implementation orders differently

matched_action_only.prior: same prior original selected events from SAME actor and family, action ignoring mission/heading/front

original_outcomes_source_flags: selected original positive terminal source reward
output: native original selected action type distribution
pre-prior selected task-relevant source effect availability
actual observed source task effect counts
selected proposal state/act SHA evidence and no counterfactual reward claim
diagnostic.no_native_execution: source-only analytic reconstruction of exact opt-in proposal rule on previously selected original MG23 prefix, NOT an actual MG28 policy invocation, and never a performed counterfactual original-world action
diagnostic.promotion_rule: Do NOT authorize native world rollout unless both genuinely native exact original actor decision divergence and incremental advantage over strongest action-only AND task-relevant genuine source outcomes can be shown on independently frozen new evaluation cohort; this retrospective diagnostic cannot meet these conditions
